name: app-user-flow-tree-with-blue-active-path-and-fading-title
title: User Flow Tree with Blue Active Path
whatItIs: A pale grey slide with a numbered User Flow pill, a headline fading from dark to light 'Simple, Seamless User Journey', a paragraph, and a left-to-right tree of pills where the main path (Welcome, Home, Dashboard, Distribution Overview) is outlined or filled in blue and other nodes are grey.
whatItMeans: A blue path through grey nodes shows the happy path at a glance, and the fading title gives depth.
techniques: Blue outlines and fills for the main path
Elbow connectors from a central hub
Filled blue pills for the key destinations

vocabulary.definition: The ideal route a user takes through a flow.
A node from which several branches leave.
A headline whose lines lose contrast as they descend.
